answers.moment: When Darren told me about Bridgwater Carnival in November. Huge carts covered in thousands of bulbs, some a hundred feet long, built in sheds by people in their spare time. He said he used to help build them with his uncle. Then the call ended.
answers.reason: I didnt expect it at all, I had him down as more pub and cricket. The engineering side got me straight away, how you get something that long round a corner, the wiring etc. He said I'd love it, and he was right. Bit annoyed the time ran out just when it got interesting.
